tasks.label: Launch Pixel 10
args: $avd = 'Pixel_10'; $devices = flutter devices --machine | ConvertFrom-Json; if (-not ($devices | Where-Object { $_.id -like 'emulator-*' })) { flutter emulators --launch $avd; $ready = $false; for ($i = 0; $i -lt 60; $i++) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $devices = flutter devices --machine | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($devices | Where-Object { $_.id -like 'emulator-*' -and $_.id -eq 'emulator-5554' }) { $ready = $true; break } }; if (-not $ready) { throw 'Pixel 10 emulator did not become ready within 120 seconds.' } }
